evidence_path_note: Raw reports, ledger and manifests retain their original absolute authoring paths. Portable copies are in the declared repo-relative paths. Historical unshipped images require the external archive; they are not retagged as current-source evidence.
production_recipe_note: Current accepted saved scene is the starting point. Frozen stage integration and finite warm/cold checks do not assert that a fresh full pipeline recreates the exact saved-scene bytes.
